decisions.reason: The dump truck line has sustained investment, public commitment, and centrality to the firm's underground mining portfolio, so escalation pressures make withdrawal very unlikely.
As a single construction dumper without a full line, it has lower sunk costs and less visible commitment than multi-model lines, but escalation pressures still favor keeping it.
The inclined furniture lift is a multi-model line with dedicated website presence, indicating substantial investment and public commitment that discourage withdrawal.
The inclined building material lift line similarly represents a multi-model public commitment, making persistence likely despite any disappointing results.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is a single-product variant with thinner commitment than full lines, so it has a somewhat higher withdrawal chance, though escalation still favors keeping it.
